name: Havana Club
description: Boston's hot spot for Bachata and Salsa dancing in Cambridge. Lessons + social dancing every night. Amazing venue, inexpensive parking garage next door, public transportation one block away on Mass Ave.

Your weekly fix for all your dancing needs.

9:00pm – 10:00pm Bachata Lesson (Beginner/Intermediate)
10:00pm – 12:00am Social Dancing (Bachata, Salsa, Merengue)

name: Dante's Salsa Fridays
location: Dante Alighieri Society, 41 Hampshire St, Cambridge, MA 02139
description:
Friday salsa/bachata socials at the Dante Alighieri Society. Dante's Salsa Inferno is the usual brand; Fuego y Candela and occasional Tambó nights share the hall. Cadence drifts (biweekly earlier in 2026, roughly monthly since May) — never invent dates from the pattern. Map pins come only from scraped Facebook/calendar listings.

8:30pm – 9:30pm Beginner Lesson
9:30pm – 1:00am Social Dancing

Plenty of dance space, parking lot, powerful A/C, and a full cash bar. Check the Facebook pages for the next confirmed night.
recurrenceLabel: Fridays at the Dante — dates vary, check FB
